The '''Landing Bay 124A''' was a landing bay in [[Port Town (Cloud City)/Legends|Port Town]], a district in [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] it was owned by the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Vorse Tabarith]] and managed by [[Hressk]].
